<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

GLM KDA under interleaved context parallelism gathers the input hidden states before executing its merged input projection. This exposes communication latency on the critical path.

This change overlaps CP input gathering with projection GEMMs using PyTorch's fused AllGather–matmul operation. It retains the existing KDA state-update and output-reduction behavior and supports CUDA Graph capture and replay.


## Modifications

- Add an opt-in `SGLANG_ENABLE_KDA_CP_ASYNC_TP` environment variable, disabled by default.
- Keep KDA inputs CP-sharded until the merged projection and use `torch.ops.symm_mem.fused_all_gather_matmul` to overlap communication and computation.
- Restore sequence order after projection instead of before projection. This preserves the semantics of the bias-free, row-wise linear operation.
- Extend layer-boundary declarations with compute-owned CP input gathering, avoiding a duplicate boundary AllGather.
- Preallocate symmetric-memory workspace before prefill CUDA Graph capture.
- Retain the original gather-and-project path for small batches, unsupported projections/layouts, and requests exceeding the reserved graph workspace.
- Add a boundary regression test covering input-gather ownership and preservation of the output-reduction contract.

The optimized path currently targets interleaved CP/TP group-sharing configurations with CP=TP>1 and attention DP=1. It requires contiguous BF16 inputs and unquantized BF16 merged projection weights, with at least 4,096 local token rows.

This optimization does not depend on MoE FP8 transport or the Q8 attention backend.
## Accuracy Tests

- Layer-boundary regression tests: **9 passed**.
- FakeTensor shape inference and CPU fallback checks passed.
- Four-GPU numerical validation completed on **4× NVIDIA H200** using:
  - Actual GLM layer-0 KDA projection weights.
  - TP4 merged weight shape: **[6416, 4096] per rank**.
  - Rank-distinct synthetic BF16 inputs.
  - Global token counts: **16,384, 17,408, 32,768, and 65,536**.

For all tested shapes and all four ranks:

- Optimized outputs matched the baseline **element-for-element**.
- Maximum absolute difference: **0**.
- Relative RMSE between optimized and baseline outputs: **0**.
- Both paths had approximately **0.00166 relative RMSE** against an FP32 reference.
- CUDA Graph replay checks passed after modifying the captured input buffers.

Targeted Ruff, isort, formatting, registered-test validation, and `git diff --check` passed.

These tests validate the gather/projection/reorder chain. Full-model GSM8K and end-to-end serving validation have not been run for this branch.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Measured on **4× NVIDIA H200**, using PyTorch **2.14.1+cu130** and NCCL **2.30.7**.

Compared paths:

```text
Baseline:
BF16 AllGather → restore sequence order → merged projection

Optimized:
overlapped BF16 AllGather + merged projection → restore sequence order
```

Timings include communication, the merged projection, and sequence-order restoration. They exclude subsequent KDA gate projections, convolution, recurrent computation, output projection, and full-model execution.

Methodology:

- Actual GLM projection weights with synthetic BF16 inputs.
- Five alternating A/B trials.
- Twenty samples per trial.
- Each sample uses the slowest of the four ranks.
- Reported latency is the median of the five trial medians.
- Eager samples flush L2 before measurement.
- Graph measurements rotate input buffers exceeding five L2 capacities and retain intermediate/output buffers.

### Eager

| Global tokens | Baseline (ms) | Async-TP (ms) | Latency reduction |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 16,384 | 1.5936 | 1.5660 | 1.73% |
| 17,408 | 1.7034 | 1.6609 | 2.50% |
| 32,768 | 3.2568 | 3.0950 | 4.97% |
| 65,536 | 6.4113 | 6.1083 | 4.73% |

### CUDA Graph

Both variants are captured; these comparisons do not attribute CUDA Graph's own benefit to Async-TP.

| Global tokens | Baseline (ms) | Async-TP (ms) | Latency reduction |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 16,384 | 1.6807 | 1.5893 | 5.43% |
| 17,408 | 1.7530 | 1.6984 | 3.11% |
| 32,768 | 3.3268 | 3.1684 | 4.76% |
| 65,536 | 6.6667 | 6.3588 | 4.62% |

The measured benefit is modest. These are operator-chain microbenchmark results, not end-to-end model speedups. No trace-based breakdown of hidden versus exposed communication is included.

The tests used unmodified PyTorch and feature code. A short project-local `TMPDIR` was required: the longer experiment-local temporary path triggered a symmetric-memory initialization crash in the test environment.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

     # numerical / index violations instead of getting silent NaN cascades.
+    # Overlap GLM KDA CP input gathering with the BF16 merged projection.
+    SGLANG_ENABLE_KDA_CP_ASYNC_TP = EnvBool(False)
+
     SGLANG_ENABLE_ASYNC_ASSERT = EnvBool(False)
     SGLANG_ENABLE_NAN_LOGITS_CHECK = EnvBool(False)
     # Signal level for value/index validity checks (nan/inf/oob/...); see

@@ -0,0 +1,135 @@
+"""Opt-in CP input gather/projection overlap for GLM KDA.
+
+The mixer keeps its inputs CP-sharded until the first projection. Output
+reduction, mHC residual placement and recurrent state ownership are unchanged.
+Small batches and unsupported layouts retain the original path. Graph support
+reserves its symmetric workspace before capture, using the same feature switch.
+"""
+
+import logging
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+
+_GRAPH_WORKSPACE_CAPACITY: dict[tuple[int, str], int] = {}
+_CAPTURE_LOGGED = False
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def prepare_kda_cp_async_graph(max_local_tokens: int, hidden_size: int, device):
+    """Reserve a fixed workspace outside capture; never grow a captured pool."""
+    if not kda_cp_async_tp_enabled():
+        return
+    from torch.distributed import _symmetric_memory as symm_mem
+
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+    with torch.cuda.device(device):
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            raise RuntimeError("KDA Async-TP workspace must be prepared before capture")
+        group_name = get_parallel().attn_cp_group.device_group.group_name
+        capacity = max_local_tokens * hidden_size * 2  # BF16 input shard
+        symm_mem.get_symm_mem_workspace(group_name, min_size=capacity)
+        # Create the communication stream before graph capture as well.
+        symm_mem._get_backend_stream()
+        _GRAPH_WORKSPACE_CAPACITY[(torch.cuda.current_device(), group_name)] = capacity
+
+
+@torch.library.custom_op(
+    "sglang::kda_cp_async_graph_projection", mutates_args=(), device_types="cuda"
+)
+def _kda_cp_async_graph_projection(
+    shard: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, group_name: str, cp_size: int
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Opaque compiler boundary retaining PyTorch's multi-stream Async-TP."""
+    global _CAPTURE_LOGGED
+    from torch.distributed import _symmetric_memory as symm_mem  # noqa: F401
+
+    capacity = _GRAPH_WORKSPACE_CAPACITY.get((shard.device.index, group_name), 0)
+    if shard.numel() * shard.element_size() > capacity:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "KDA Async-TP graph workspace is not prepared for this shape"
+        )
+    if not _CAPTURE_LOGGED and torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+        logger.info(
+            "KDA Async-TP BCG capture: local_rows=%s, hidden=%s, output=%s, workspace_bytes=%s",
+            shard.shape[0],
+            shard.shape[1],
+            weight.shape[0],
+            capacity,
+        )
+        _CAPTURE_LOGGED = True
+    _, outputs = torch.ops.symm_mem.fused_all_gather_matmul(
+        shard, [weight.t()], 0, group_name, return_A=False
+    )
+    return outputs[0]
+
+
+@_kda_cp_async_graph_projection.register_fake
+def _kda_cp_async_graph_projection_fake(shard, weight, group_name, cp_size):
+    return shard.new_empty((shard.shape[0] * cp_size, weight.shape[0]))
+
+
+def kda_cp_async_tp_enabled() -> bool:
+    if not envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_KDA_CP_ASYNC_TP.get() or torch.version.cuda is None:
+        return False
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+    p = get_parallel()
+    return (
+        p.enable_prefill_cp
+        and p.enable_cp_tp_group_sharing
+        and p.cp_strategy == "interleave"
+        and p.attn_cp_size == p.tp_size
+        and p.attn_cp_size > 1
+        and p.attn_dp_size == 1
+    )
+
+
+def try_kda_cp_async_projection(shard: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor):
+    """Return rank-major projected rows, or None for the original path.
+
+    Only the unquantized, bias-free BF16 merged projection is audited. The
+    caller restores sequence order *after* projection, then runs the same
+    KDA gate projections, convolution and recurrent update as before.
+    """
+    if (
+        not shard.is_cuda
+        or shard.ndim != 2
+        or shard.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+        or weight.ndim != 2
+        or weight.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+        or weight.shape[1] != shard.shape[1]
+        or shard.shape[0] < 4096
+        or not shard.is_contiguous()
+        or not weight.is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        return None
+    # Importing the module registers the Python CUDA implementations of the op.
+    from torch.distributed import _symmetric_memory as _symm_mem  # noqa: F401
+
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+    group = get_parallel().attn_cp_group.device_group
+    if (
+        torch.compiler.is_compiling()
+        or torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+        or (shard.device.index, group.group_name) in _GRAPH_WORKSPACE_CAPACITY
+    ):
+        capacity = _GRAPH_WORKSPACE_CAPACITY.get(
+            (shard.device.index, group.group_name), 0
+        )
+        if shard.numel() * shard.element_size() > capacity:
+            # Larger eager requests must not invalidate workspace retained by
+            # existing graphs. The caller falls back to its ordinary gather.
+            return None
+        return _kda_cp_async_graph_projection(
+            shard, weight, group.group_name, get_parallel().attn_cp_size
+        )
+    # PyTorch owns the symmetric workspace and shard/GEMM stream dependencies.
+    # All CP ranks must invoke this with the same physical shard shape.
+    _, outputs = torch.ops.symm_mem.fused_all_gather_matmul(
+        shard, [weight.t()], 0, group.group_name, return_A=False
+    )
+    return outputs[0]

+    def test_kda_compute_owned_cp_gather_preserves_output_contract(self):

+        from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary import SumGroup, TokenAxis
+
+        parallel = fixture.parallel_of(
+            attn_dp=1,
+            attn_tp=1,
+            attn_cp=4,
+            enable_prefill_cp=True,
+            enable_cp_tp_group_sharing=True,
+            cp_strategy="interleave",
+        )
+        with fixture.planning(parallel, dsa_cp=True):
+            baseline = build_stages(
+                (declare_attn(tp_group=SumGroup.TP), fixture.Norm()),
+                (declare_ffn(sparse=True), fixture.Norm()),
+            )[0]
+            optimized = build_stages(
+                (
+                    declare_attn(tp_group=SumGroup.TP, gathers_attn_cp_input=True),
+                    fixture.Norm(),
+                ),
+                (declare_ffn(sparse=True), fixture.Norm()),
+            )[0]
+            for variant in baseline.plan.edges:
+                a = baseline.plan.edges[variant]
+                b = optimized.plan.edges[variant]
+                self.assertEqual(a.outgoing, b.outgoing)
+                self.assertEqual(a.incoming.residual_to, b.incoming.residual_to)
+                expected = (
+                    frozenset({TokenAxis.ATTN_CP})
+                    if variant is BatchVariant.CONTEXT_PARALLEL
+                    else frozenset()
+                )

+                self.assertEqual(a.incoming.need.layout, b.incoming.need.layout)
+        declaration = declare_attn(tp_group=SumGroup.TP, gathers_attn_cp_input=True)
+        self.assertTrue(facts_of(declaration).gathers_attn_cp_input)
